# JS Schools

> > Comprehensive programming education platform offering courses and tutorials in JavaScript, TypeScript, Go, Java Spring Boot, and modern web development technologies.

JS Schools provides hands-on training in full-stack development, covering frontend frameworks like React and Vue.js, backend technologies including Node.js and Spring Boot, and systems programming with Go. The platform emphasizes practical skills in testing, performance optimization, and asynchronous programming patterns.

## Key Topics

- JavaScript
- TypeScript
- React
- Node.js
- Go (Golang)
- Java Spring Boot
- Jest & Cypress Testing
- Performance Optimization
- Asynchronous Programming
- Concurrency Patterns
- Full-Stack Development
- Docker
- React Native
- Vue.js
- Web Development

## Course Catalog

- [JS Schools Courses](https://courses.jsschools.com/): Main course catalog for JavaScript, TypeScript, and Java Spring Boot
- [JS Schools Home](https://jsschools.com/): Homepage for programming tutorials in Go, JavaScript, and Python

## JavaScript & Web Development

- [JavaScript Tutorials](https://jsschools.com/javascript/): JavaScript guides on testing, React patterns, Node.js APIs, and security
- [Turbocharge Your React Native App](https://jsschools.com/javascript/turbocharge-your-react-native-app-secrets-to-smoother-faster-performance/): React Native performance optimization with Fabric and component techniques

## Go Programming

- [Golang Tutorials](https://jsschools.com/golang/): Golang tutorials covering concurrency, profiling, and code generation

## Programming Fundamentals

- [Mastering Asynchronous Programming](https://jsschools.com/programming/mastering-asynchronous-programming-essential-pa/): Async patterns guide: callbacks, promises, async/await in JavaScript & Java
